sonnetLines: The gold remembers how to shine,
No longer bound by fading grace.
A burning truth, a vibrant sign,
To leave the ghosts of time and place.
Let dawn erase the heavy stain,
Where whispers held you in their keep.
Walk through the light and break the chain,
From secrets that were buried deep.
The sun demands your steady gaze,
No turning back to what has been.
A stronger self will rise within.
Chase down the shadow's final trace,
And claim this bright and open space.
